title.zh: 传染病（HIV 病毒载量检测不到）条例 2024
title.en: Infectious Diseases (Undetectable HIV Viral Load) Regulations 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Infectious Diseases (Undetectable HIV Viral Load) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 9 April 2024.
2. For the purpose of section 23(1A) and (1B) of the Act, the prescribed period preceding the sexual activity in question for which a person has maintained an undetectable HIV viral load is 6 months.

3. For the purpose of section 23(1B) of the Act —
(a)in section 23(1B)(a) of the Act, the prescribed period within which the person must have taken the test mentioned in that provision is 9 months before the sexual activity; and
(b)in section 23(1B)(b) of the Act, the earlier test mentioned in that provision must have been taken no later than 6 months before the test mentioned in paragraph (a).

heading.en: Prescribed amount of HIV viral load

text.en:
4. For the purpose of section 23(1C) of the Act —
(a)in section 23(1C)(a) of the Act, the prescribed amount of HIV for a detectable HIV viral load is 200 copies per millilitre of blood; and
(b)in section 23(1C)(b) of the Act, the prescribed amount of HIV for an undetectable HIV viral load is below 200 copies per millilitre of blood.

heading.en: Person licensed to provide clinical laboratory service to be recognised laboratory

text.en: 5. A person who is licensed under the Healthcare Services Act 2020 to provide a clinical laboratory service within the meaning of the First Schedule to that Act is a recognised laboratory mentioned in section 23(1B) of the Act.
